en.name: Ricotta
en.summary: Ricotta is a soft fresh cheese made by recooking whey until fine curds form — mild, milky and very perishable. Unopened it keeps about 2 weeks from purchase in the fridge; once opened, about 1 week.
en.pantry: Ricotta has no room-temperature life at all. It is one of the wettest and least acidic cheeses there is, which is the profile that supports Listeria monocytogenes, an organism that grows even at fridge temperature — so buy it made with pasteurised milk and keep it cold. Follow the 2-hour rule when it is out, or 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Carry it home cold and do not leave the tub out while you assemble a lasagne.
en.fridge: Keep ricotta at 4 °C (40 °F) or below on an inside shelf, not in the door. Unopened it runs about 2 weeks from purchase, or to the printed date if that comes first. Once opened, use it within about 1 week: press the surface flat, keep the lid on tight, and always use a clean spoon. Some clear whey separating out is normal and can be poured off or stirred back; if you want firmer ricotta for a filling, drain it in a sieve in the fridge rather than on the counter.
en.freezer: There is no published freezer timeline for ricotta, and it does not freeze gracefully: the fine curds separate from the whey and the thawed cheese is grainy and watery. It is still usable that way in a baked dish — a filling, a pasta bake, a cake — but never again as a spoonable fresh cheese. If you do freeze it, use −18 °C (0 °F), drain it first, and label the date. Buying the smaller tub is generally better.
en.thawing: Thaw it in the fridge, never on the counter, drain off the water it releases, and use it in a cooked dish. Do not refreeze it.
spoilage: Mould of any colour on the surface or under the lid.
A sour, yeasty or sharply acidic smell instead of a sweet milky one.
A yellow or pink cast to what should be bright white.
A ropy or slimy texture, a fizzy taste, or a bulging lid.
tips: Buy the size you will use within a week of opening.
Drain it in the fridge for a firmer filling, not at room temperature.
Write the opening date on the lid.

faq.q: How long does ricotta last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 2 weeks from purchase unopened, and about 1 week once opened, at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
There is no established timeline. It thaws grainy and watery, so it is only good in baked dishes afterwards.

faq.q: Is the liquid on top of ricotta normal?
faq.a: Yes, that is whey. Pour it off or stir it back. Mould, a pink cast or a fizzy taste means the tub goes.
Choose one made with pasteurised milk and keep it properly cold, or use it in a thoroughly cooked dish. It is a fresh, low-acid cheese and Listeria grows at fridge temperature.

zh.name: 瑞可塔乳酪
zh.summary: 瑞可塔是把乳清再次加熱、讓細緻凝乳析出而做成的軟質新鮮乳酪，味道溫和帶奶香，也非常容易腐敗。未開封冷藏從購買日起約 2 週；開封後約 1 週。
zh.pantry: 瑞可塔完全沒有室溫保存這回事。它是所有乳酪裡含水量最高、酸度最低的之一，正是有利於李斯特菌的條件，而這種菌連冷藏溫度都能生長——請選巴氏殺菌乳製作的並保持低溫。離開冰箱後守 2 小時原則（廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時）。回家路上保冷，組裝千層麵時也不要把整盒晾在檯面上。
zh.fridge: 放在 4 °C 以下的內側層架，不要放門邊。未開封從購買日起約 2 週，或以包裝日期為準（取先到者）。開封後約 1 週內用完：表面抹平、蓋子蓋緊，每次都用乾淨的湯匙。分離出一些透明乳清是正常的，倒掉或攪回去都行；想要做內餡用的紮實質地，請放在冰箱裡用篩網瀝，不要放在室溫瀝。
zh.freezer: 瑞可塔沒有公告的冷凍期限，而且它冷凍表現不佳：細緻凝乳會和乳清分離，解凍後又粗又水。那樣的狀態還是可以用在烘烤料理——內餡、焗烤麵、蛋糕——但再也回不去可以用湯匙吃的鮮乳酪。真要冷凍，請先瀝乾、放 −18 °C 並標上日期。通常買小盒更划算。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫；把釋出的水倒掉，用在加熱料理。不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 表面或蓋內出現任何顏色的霉。
聞起來發酸、有酵母味或尖銳酸味，而不是香甜奶味。
本該潔白的部分泛黃或泛粉紅。
質地牽絲黏滑、吃起來有氣泡感，或蓋子鼓起。
tips: 買開封後一週內用得完的容量。
每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙。
要瀝乾請放冰箱瀝，不要放室溫。

faq.q: 瑞可塔乳酪冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封從購買日起約 2 週，開封後約 1 週，皆放 4 °C 以下。
沒有既定期限。解凍後又粗又水，之後只適合用在烘烤料理。

faq.q: 瑞可塔上面那層水正常嗎？
faq.a: 正常，那是乳清，倒掉或攪回去都可以。長霉、泛粉紅或吃起來有氣泡感就要整盒丟棄。
請選巴氏殺菌乳製作的並全程冷藏，或用在徹底加熱的料理中。它是低酸新鮮乳酪，而李斯特菌在冷藏溫度下仍會生長。
